thread:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up — thanks everyone for the writeup. We still have a long tail of ~1.2k affected invoices from the delayed token ingest. Need to triage corrections, owners, and a hard timeline.
kevin: I can take the reprocess pipeline changes. planning to add a dedupe step and shorter backoff for late batches. owner: kevin. ETA: EOW for a patch. :thumbsup:
sam: For infra, I can provision a temporary batch runner (spot fleet) to run the backfill without impacting production. Need list of account IDs and an estimate of compute minutes.
maria: Natalie — can you scope how many invoices need manual adjustments vs automated credits? Also which accounts are sensitive (enterprise / reserved)?
natalie: Looking now. Rough split: ~920 auto-credits, ~300 manual adjustments (enterprise/legal). I'll post a CSV by tomorrow AM and flag the 30 enterprise accounts. owner: natalie. ETA: tomorrow 10:00 PT.
raj: Noted a pattern: delayed token buckets spike on Tuesdays after deploys. We should add a canary ingest check and a trend alert. owner: raj. Suggested alert: if ingest lag > 45m for >2% of requests in 1h window.
kevin: SQL I used to find affected accounts:```sql
SELECT account_id, count(*) as delayed_tokens
FROM token_ingest_log
WHERE processed_ts - event_ts > 3600
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY delayed_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
maria: Nice. Can we also surface a raw token delta per invoice so billing ops can reconcile quickly?
natalie: I'll add two extra columns (expected_tokens, actual_tokens) to the CSV. For manual adj we need: account_id, invoice_id, delta, reason_code, approver.
kevin: For automated credits, I propose a one-time credit job that updates ledger with a tag so we can audit: tag=postmortem-2923456780. I'll open a PR and a changelog entry.
sam: Running the backfill runner will take ~6 hours with current quota if we parallelize. If kevin's dedupe reduces duplicates we could cut it to ~3h. I'll schedule after kevin's patch merges.
maria: Risk call: will the credit job create double-billing risk if reprocess finishes later? We need an orchestration plan: backfill first, then credit job for remaining deltas, not both simultaneously.
kevin: Agreed. Plan: 1) merge dedupe + reprocess; 2) run backfill; 3) generate diff; 4) apply auto-credits for accounts marked auto in CSV; 5) manual adjustments for flagged accounts. I'll add a playbook to the PR.
natalie: I'll prepare the manual adjustment ticket template and link legal approval workflow where needed.
raj: I'll add the ingest-lag alert and a Grafana dashboard panel showing weekly pattern. Also suggest a weekly digest to catch regressions.
maria: Owners recap: kevin (reprocess code + PR), sam (backfill infra + runner schedule), natalie (CSV + manual adj), raj (monitoring/alert). Timeline: natalie CSV by tomorrow 10:00 PT, kevin patch EOW, backfill earliest Sat 02:00 PT, credits Mon after verification.
kevin: I'll file JIRA: BILL-5843 and link it here.
maria: Please post status updates in this thread. If any blockers ping me directly. Thanks all. :heart:
